monitor.diagnosticMethodWindowText: Compares two adjacent windows of up to 60 raw valid records each. Shorter histories use half the available records per window.
monitor.diagnosticMethodVolatilityText: Recent-window standard deviation divided by the absolute recent mean. It measures relative noise, not output quality.
monitor.diagnosticMethodNote: Diagnostics use the last 120 raw records, independently of chart downsampling. Open TensorBoard for full curves and point-level inspection.

field.pretrained_model_name_or_pathHint: Accepts .safetensors / .ckpt model files or a Diffusers-format directory.
field.pretrained_model_name_or_pathHint_anima: Select Cosmos-Predict2-2B derivative weights compatible with Anima.
field.vaeHint: Encodes between images and latents; optional for SDXL and required for Anima.
field.vaeHint_anima: Anima requires a compatible QwenImage VAE.
field.vaeHint_sdxl: Leave blank to use the VAE bundled with the SDXL base model.
field.krea_ditHint: LoRA training uses the RAW checkpoint. The Turbo checkpoint belongs only in the Turbo DiT field for samples generated during training.
field.krea_vaeHint: Encodes training images into the latent cache.
field.krea_text_encoderHint: Generates the text cache and is loaded temporarily for samples during training.
field.krea_dataset_cache_dirHint: Stored below the training data directory. Rebuild after changing images, captions, resolution, buckets, VAE, or text encoder. Changing the training DiT does not invalidate it.
field.krea_resolutionHint: Width and height must be positive multiples of 16, in width,height format.
field.krea_network_argsHint: One key=value per line, passed directly as the trainer's --network_args.
field.krea_weighting_schemeHint: logit_normal and mode change only sigma sampling density; sigma_sqrt and cosmap change only per-timestep Loss weights; none adds no adjustment.
field.krea_learning_rateHint: Controls the overall step size for DiT LoRA parameter updates. This training path has no separate text-encoder learning rate.
field.krea_logit_meanHint: Used by logsnr sampling and by timestep density with sigma + logit_normal.
field.krea_logit_stdHint: Used by logsnr sampling and by timestep density with sigma + logit_normal.
field.krea_mode_scaleHint: Changes sampling density only when timestep_sampling=sigma and weighting_scheme=mode.
field.krea_optimizer_weight_decayHint: Controls parameter shrinkage during updates. Whether decay is decoupled from the gradient depends on the selected optimizer; 0 applies no weight decay.
field.krea_optimizer_betasHint: Controls how much history is retained by the optimizer's exponential moving-average states. The required count and meaning of each value depend on the selected optimizer.
field.krea_optimizer_epsHint: A stability term added to adaptive-scaling denominators or related statistics to limit numerical amplification when a denominator approaches zero.
field.krea_prodigy_d_coefHint: D is the learning rate the optimizer estimates for itself during training. This coefficient is a multiplier on D: the higher it is, the higher the effective learning rate. Default 1.0; 0.5 and 2.0 are common values.
field.krea_prodigy_d0Hint: D for Prodigy and ProdigyPlus starts from this value and only grows during training, so it is also the lowest learning rate. Default 1e-6.
field.krea_schedulefree_warmup_stepsHint: Controls only AdamWScheduleFree linear warmup; external lr_warmup_steps and the LR scheduler do not apply.
field.krea_adafactor_relative_stepHint: When enabled, the entered LR is the initial value and AdaFactor derives later steps from training progress; the external scheduler does not apply. Disable it to use a normal external scheduler.
field.krea_adafactor_scale_parameter: Scale AdaFactor steps by parameter size
field.krea_adafactor_scale_parameterHint: When enabled, scales each parameter's step by that parameter's RMS. When disabled, the entered learning rate is used without parameter-RMS scaling.
field.krea_adafactor_warmup_initHint: Only applies in relative-step mode; AdaFactor performs the warmup internally.
field.krea_lr_scheduler_internalLocked: This optimizer manages its own learning rate, so the external scheduler is disabled; constant is shown only as a configuration placeholder.
field.krea_lr_scheduler_timescaleHint: Controls decay speed after warmup. Empty uses the warmup steps when nonzero, or 10000 when warmup is 0.
field.krea_lr_scheduler_min_lr_ratioHint: Minimum LR = base LR × this ratio. Used by cosine_with_min_lr, warmup_stable_decay, and rex; empty means 0.01 for REX and 0 for the other two.
field.krea_lr_scheduler_num_cyclesHint: For cosine_with_restarts this is the restart count; for cosine_with_min_lr it is the cosine cycle count; for warmup_stable_decay it is the final decay cycle count.
field.krea_fp8_baseHint: Dynamically quantizes target linear layers in the main DiT blocks at load time while leaving other layers at their original precision. Enabling it passes both fp8_base and fp8_scaled.
field.krea_compileHint: Compiles the Krea 2 DiT graph. The first run needs compilation time and compatibility depends on the current PyTorch, Triton, and GPU environment.
field.krea_text_cache_batch_sizeHint: Only affects text-cache preparation speed and VRAM usage.
field.krea_gradient_checkpointing_cpu_offloadH: Only selectable with gradient checkpointing enabled. The current Krea 2 version does not implement this offload, so enabling it has no effect yet.
field.krea_ratio_or_stepsHint: Use a whole number of steps, or a ratio below 1 (for example 0.1 means 10% of total steps).
field.krea_lr_decay_stepsHint: Used only by warmup_stable_decay. Enter whole steps or a ratio below 1 of total steps; 0 leaves no final decay segment.
field.krea_use_pinned_memory_for_block_swap: Use pinned memory for block swap
field.krea_use_pinned_memory_for_block_swapHin: Can speed up CPU-to-GPU transfers; on Windows it uses more shared GPU memory.
field.krea_block_swap_h2d_onlyHint: Avoids backward D2H transfers and requires gradient checkpointing.
field.enable_krea_samplesHint: Samples are written to the run's output/sample directory and temporarily load the text encoder at training start.
field.krea_sample_promptsHint: One prompt per line; sampling flags such as --w --h --s --g --d are supported.
field.krea_turbo_ditHint: Used for training samples and cannot be combined with block swap.
field.krea_turbo_dit_cache: Keep Turbo DiT resident in CPU memory
field.krea_turbo_dit_cacheHint: Faster samples, but uses roughly one additional DiT's worth of CPU RAM for the run.
field.resumeHint: Restores saved model parameters, optimizer state, and training progress to continue the previous run.
field.enable_reg_dataHint: Adds images from the same class to help preserve the model’s ability to generate that class while learning the target character or concept.
field.reg_data_dirHint: Directory of regularization images. Same structure as the training dataset: subfolders named "repeats_classname" (e.g. 10_face). Must be a separate directory, not inside the training data directory.
field.resolutionHint: Enter width,height, for example 1024,768. Both Anima dimensions must be multiples of 16; SDXL dimensions must be multiples of 32.
field.enable_bucketHint: Groups images with similar aspect ratios for training, helping preserve their proportions and reduce cropping.
field.bucket_no_upscaleHint: Avoids enlarging small images to the training size, so blur and compression artifacts are not magnified.
field.bucket_reso_stepsHint: Must be a positive multiple of 16 for Anima or 32 for SDXL.
field.save_every_n_stepsHint: Saves models by parameter-update count. Can be used alongside epoch-based saves.
field.save_stateHint: Saves optimizer, scheduler, and other training state for a full resume. This is separate from saving LoRA weights alone.
field.save_last_n_epochs_state: Number of epoch states to keep
field.train_batch_sizeHint: Number of images processed together. Larger batches usually use more GPU memory and change how many samples contribute to each update.
field.gradient_accumulation_stepsHint: Number of batches to accumulate before updating the parameters. A value of 4 combines gradients from four batches into one update.
field.gradient_checkpointingHint: Recomputes some intermediate results during backpropagation instead of storing them. Saves GPU memory, usually at the cost of slower training.
field.learning_rateHint: Controls the size of each parameter update. Higher values can speed up learning, but values that are too high can make training unstable or cause earlier overfitting.
field.learning_rateHint_lora_muon: Controls the size of each LoRA-Muon update. Its learning rate uses a different scale from AdamW, so copying a small AdamW value can make learning very weak.
field.unet_lrHint: Leave blank to use the base learning rate.
field.unet_lrHint_anima: Leave blank to use the base learning rate.
field.text_encoder_lrHint: Applies only when training the text encoder. Leave blank to use the base learning rate.
field.lr_schedulerHint: Controls how the learning rate changes during training.
field.lr_warmup_stepsHint: Gradually raises the learning rate at the start of training to avoid large initial updates. Enter a step count or a fraction of the total steps; 0.1 means 10%.
field.weight_decayHint: Shrinks trainable weights during updates to limit their growth. Excessive decay can hinder fitting. Set to 0 to disable.
field.bnb_percentile_clippingHint: Uses recent gradient norms to scale down unusually large gradients. Lower values clip more strongly. Set to 100 to disable.
field.bnb_min_8bit_sizeHint: Parameter tensors below this element count keep 32-bit optimizer states. A higher threshold quantizes fewer small tensors but uses more memory.
field.stableadamw_kahan_sumHint: Compensates for rounding errors in low-precision parameter updates so small changes are less likely to be lost. Mainly useful for FP16 or BF16 trainable parameters.
field.stableadamw_weight_decoupleHint: Uses AdamW-style decoupled decay. It has no practical effect while weight_decay is 0.
field.muon_adjust_lr_fnHint: Selects how matrix updates are scaled. The AdamW-matching rule offers a starting point for comparisons, but does not make the actual updates identical to AdamW’s.
field.muon_momentumHint: Controls how much gradient history contributes to the current update; normally leave it at 0.95.
field.muon_nesterovHint: Uses Nesterov momentum for the update before orthogonalization.
field.muon_ns_stepsHint: Number of iterations used to orthogonalize the update. More iterations require more computation; with the current coefficients, they do not necessarily improve accuracy.
field.muon_ns_coefficientsHint: The three coefficients used by the Newton-Schulz iteration. Keep the defaults unless you are running a controlled comparison.
field.lora_muon_momentumHint: Higher values give more weight to past gradient directions, usually smoothing updates but slowing their response to changes.
field.lora_muon_ns_stepsHint: Number of iterations used to approximate the matrix-sign direction. Fewer iterations reduce computation but change the approximation.
field.lora_muon_inv_sqrt_stepsHint: Number of matrix iterations used to adjust the scales of the two LoRA factors. Fewer iterations save computation but change the approximation.
field.lora_muon_msign_epsHint: Protects the matrix-sign calculation against very small denominators. Usually does not need adjustment.
field.lora_muon_inv_sqrt_epsHint: Stabilizes factor-scale correction when a matrix is close to singular. Large values also alter the update, so the default is usually appropriate.
field.lora_muon_inv_sqrt_gammaHint: Adjusts damping in the matrix inverse square root iteration for numerical stability. The default is usually appropriate.
field.lora_muon_gauge_rebalanceHint: Periodically balances the two LoRA factors so one does not become much larger than the other. Rebalancing preserves the weight change represented by their product.
field.lora_muon_gauge_rebalance_alphaHint: Controls how strongly each rebalance adjusts the factor scales. Lower values make smaller adjustments.
field.lora_muon_gauge_rebalance_intervalHint: Number of parameter updates between rebalancing operations. A value of 10 rebalances the factors after every 10 updates.
field.lora_muon_gauge_power_stepsHint: Estimates the maximum amplification of each factor to assess their scale imbalance. More iterations add computation.
field.lora_muonNetworkAutoSelected: LoRA-Muon supports only Anima native LoRA; the network module was switched to networks.lora_anima.
field.lora_muonOptimizerAutoDisabled: The selected network module does not support LoRA-Muon; the optimizer was switched to AdamW8bit.
field.adan_weight_decoupleHint: Uses AdamW-style weight decay. Has no effect when weight decay is 0.
field.ademamix_alphaHint: Controls how strongly long-term gradient trends influence updates. Higher values emphasize those trends and can make new changes less prominent in short runs. It does not change the history’s decay rate.
field.ademamix_t_alphaHint: Gradually increases the influence of slow momentum instead of applying its full weight before enough history has accumulated. Leave blank to use the estimated total steps; 0 applies the target weight immediately.
field.ademamix_t_beta3Hint: Gradually changes slow momentum from responding quickly to retaining a longer history. Leave blank to use the estimated total steps; 0 uses the target decay rate immediately.
field.lorarite_clip_unmagnified_gradHint: Suppresses the effect of occasional gradient spikes on the update; the default is sufficient in most cases. The norm is measured after removing the scaling induced by the LoRA factors. When LoRA-RITE is selected, the max_grad_norm field above (global gradient clipping threshold) locks to 0 and this setting takes over; 0 disables clipping.
field.soap_max_precondition_dimHint: Maximum axis length for matrix preconditioning. A higher limit includes longer axes but can sharply increase memory and computation.
field.soap_precondition_frequencyHint: Number of steps between recalculations of the update’s coordinate basis. Longer intervals cost less but adapt more slowly to recent gradient changes.
field.soap_shampoo_betaHint: Moving-average coefficient of the preconditioner itself; leave it empty to follow the second beta. Larger values keep more history in the basis.
field.soap_normalize_gradientHint: Normalizes each update tensor by its root mean square to reduce differences in overall update scale. It does not selectively suppress individual directions.
field.soap_correct_biasHint: Corrects the bias caused by initializing moving averages at zero. This is separate from learning rate warmup.
field.soap_precondition_1dHint: Also builds matrix preconditioners for 1-D parameters such as normalization weights when train_norm is on; those statistics cost the same square-of-length memory, so it is off by default.
field.stopcoefHint: Shows a stop suggestion once training settles and recent average loss is at or below this threshold. Higher values trigger it more easily; 0 disables it. The suggestion does not stop training.
field.notifyHint: Displays suggestions in the log about when to stop. Does not end training automatically.
field.use_shadowHint: Keeps an extra copy of the weights and blends it with the current weights when loss changes suddenly. This can soften abrupt changes but uses more GPU memory.
field.learning_rateHint_emosens: Enter a multiplier here; EmoSens adjusts the actual learning rate automatically. Start with 0.1 for Anima LoRA or 1.0 for SDXL LoRA. Keep the original value when resuming.
field.component_lrHint_emosens: EmoSens uses one learning rate for all components, so this field does not change the component's actual rate. Use the backbone-only or text-encoder-only switches to choose what to train.
field.prodigy_d_coefHint: Scales the automatic step-size estimate. Higher values generally strengthen updates, but do not multiply the final update by an exact fixed ratio.
field.prodigy_d0Hint: Initial value of the automatic step-size estimate. Higher values start with larger steps but increase the risk of excessive early updates.
field.prodigy_safeguard_warmupHint: Enabled automatically with external LR warmup so warmup does not disturb the D estimate.
field.prodigyplus_use_stableadamwHint: Limits the magnitude of internal optimizer updates by scaling down oversized updates.
field.d_limiterHint: Limits how quickly the automatic step-size estimate can rise, reducing sudden early jumps but potentially slowing its growth.
field.schedulefree_cHint: Controls how strongly the saved weight average favors recent training results. Larger positive values give recent results more weight and respond faster; 0 uses the original averaging rule.
field.prodigy_stepsHint: Freezes the step-size estimate after the specified number of steps. Set to 0 to keep estimating throughout training. An external schedule may still change the learning rate.
field.use_speedHint: Switches to an estimator based on sustained directional progress, with less state and more tolerance for gradient rescaling. Experimental; it can be unstable together with weight decay.
field.use_bias_correctionHint: Switches to the RAdam variant: bias correction combined with automatic warmup. It slows the adjustment of D considerably — up to ten times per upstream — and pairs with SPEED to mitigate that; check this first when D stops moving.
field.use_cautiousHint: Filters out update components that disagree with the current gradient. This optimizer has no first moment, so upstream applies the mask directly to the update, deviating from the paper; the effect may be limited.
field.use_orthogradHint: Updates parameters using only the gradient component orthogonal to the current weight direction. Upstream reports it can help prevent overfitting and improve generalisation.
field.factoredHint: Approximates full second-moment statistics with row and column statistics to save memory, introducing approximation error.
field.factored_fp32Hint: Stores factored statistics in FP32 to reduce rounding error. Disabling this can save memory only when a lower storage precision is available.
field.split_groupsHint: Estimates step sizes separately for each parameter group, allowing the backbone and text encoder to adapt independently. Disabling this uses one shared estimate.
field.split_groups_mean: Share an averaged D across groups
field.split_groups_meanHint: Combines the separate group estimates using their harmonic mean, which is more influenced by smaller values. Applies only when per-group estimation is enabled.
field.weight_decay_by_lr: Scale weight decay with the learning rate
field.weight_decay_by_lrHint: Scales weight decay together with D, so decay grows as D grows. It only matters when weight decay is not zero; keep it enabled unless there is a specific reason to change it.
field.schedulefree_warmup_stepsHint: The optimizer gradually raises the learning rate at the start of training. Set the warmup length here; external warmup settings have no effect.
field.adafactor_relative_stepHint: Lets AdaFactor derive LR from training steps; LoRA+ group rates are not used while enabled.
field.adafactor_warmup_initHint: Only used with relative_step; warmup is then managed inside AdaFactor.
field.adafactor_epsHint: Two-value format: eps1, eps2. eps1 applies to squared-gradient statistics and eps2 applies to parameter-scale calculation.
field.betasHint: Sets the balance between recent changes and historical trends. The role of each value depends on the optimizer.
field.betasHint_adam: Beta1 smooths gradient directions; Beta2 smooths squared-gradient statistics. Higher values retain more history and respond more slowly to changes.
field.betasHint_lion: Beta1 sets how much past momentum contributes to the current update direction. Beta2 sets how much history is retained for later updates.
field.betasHint_came: The three values smooth the update direction, squared gradients, and update residuals. The third supports confidence estimation and has no direct AdamW equivalent.
field.betasHint_prodigy: Beta1 smooths update directions; Beta2 smooths squared-gradient statistics. Automatic step-size estimation is separate, so these values do not determine the effective learning rate on their own.
field.betasHint_schedulefree: Beta1 controls how training and averaged weights are combined. Beta2 smooths squared-gradient statistics. Beta1 is not the gradient-momentum term used by ordinary AdamW.
field.betasHint_adan: The three values control the gradient average, the average change between gradients, and squared lookahead statistics. Higher values make those statistics respond more slowly.
field.betasHint_ademamix: Beta1 tracks short-term trends, Beta2 tracks squared gradients, and Beta3 tracks long-term trends. A Beta3 closer to 1 makes the long-term history decay more slowly.
field.betasHint_soap: Beta1 and Beta2 smooth gradient and squared-gradient statistics in the transformed coordinates. A separate setting controls decay in the preconditioner statistics.
field.epsHint: Prevents very small denominators from producing excessive updates. This is a numerical-stability setting, not a fidelity control.
field.epsHint_lorarite: This value is squared before use. Do not copy AdamW’s epsilon value directly.
field.epsHint_prodigyplus: Set to None to use Adam-atan2 (scale invariant, no eps needed); internal update scaling is then disabled and global gradient clipping is locked to 0.
field.automagic_max_lrHint: Hard controller LR limit used to prevent numerical overflow.
field.automagic_clip_thresholdHint: Acts only on optimizer-internal updates; does not replace max_grad_norm.
field.automagic_polarity_historyHint: Tracks recent gradient-sign agreement for each parameter. A longer window retains more sign history and responds more slowly to new sign changes.
field.automagic_fusedLocked: Set to off. Reason: fused mode requires one GPU, gradient accumulation of 1, max_grad_norm of 0, and no FP16.
field.gradient_accumulation_steps_emosensLocke: EmoSens currently does not support gradient accumulation. This value is fixed at 1.
field.emosensMultiGpuConflict: EmoSens conflict: gpu_ids is {value}; one GPU is required
field.came_weight_decoupleHint: When disabled, weight_decay enters the gradient as an L2 term. This switch has no effect when weight_decay=0.
field.came_fixed_decay: Keep per-step weight decay strength fixed
field.came_fixed_decayHint: Applies only with decoupled weight decay enabled. When enabled, the decay coefficient is no longer multiplied by the current learning rate.
field.came_clip_thresholdHint: Limits the root mean square of CAME's internal update tensor; this is separate from global max_grad_norm.
field.came_ams_boundHint: Uses the historical maximum second-moment estimate to bound adaptive step sizes so the denominator statistic cannot fall below the largest value recorded earlier.
field.came_eps1Hint: Denominator stability term for factorized squared-gradient statistics.
field.came_eps2Hint: Denominator stability term for residual-confidence statistics and update scaling.
field.optimizer_args_customHint: Enter one key=value pair per line for advanced optimizer settings.
field.lr_warmup_steps_internalLocked: This optimizer does not use external warmup, so this value is fixed at 0.
field.lr_scheduler_locked: This optimizer manages its own schedule. The external schedule is fixed to constant.
field.max_grad_norm_optimizerLocked: Global gradient clipping is disabled for this optimizer configuration and fixed at 0.
field.learning_rate_prodigyLocked: Prodigy estimates the step size automatically. This multiplier is fixed at 1.
field.unet_lr_prodigyLocked: Prodigy uses the same learning rate multiplier for all components. This value is fixed at 1.
field.text_encoder_lr_prodigyLocked: Prodigy uses the same learning rate multiplier for all components. This value is fixed at 1.
field.network_dimHint: For standard LoRA, a higher rank allows a wider range of weight changes and increases the parameter count and file size. LoHa and LoKr use dimension settings differently.
field.network_dimHint_lora_muon: Higher ranks allow a wider range of LoRA weight changes, at the cost of more parameters and matrix computation.
field.network_alphaHint: Scales the LoRA branch’s contribution to the model output. At a fixed rank, a higher Alpha makes the same LoRA weights contribute more. It also affects training, not just the saved model.
field.network_alphaHint_lora_muon: Scales the LoRA branch and affects gradients during training. Alpha does not have to equal the network dimension.
field.network_weightsHint: Starts from an existing LoRA without restoring optimizer state or training progress. Use Resume training state to restore the full training state.
field.train_adalnHint: Also trains the AdaLN layers that adjust features according to the noise level, giving the LoRA access to more of the model. This can be tested for style training, but adds parameters.
field.enable_loraplusHint: Uses different learning rates for LoRA’s two parameter groups, which may help learn the target features in fewer steps. It does not add parameters.
field.enable_loraplus_optimizerLocked: Set to off. Reason: the current trainer does not support LoRA+ with Prodigy, ProdigyPlusScheduleFree, EmoSens, LoRA-RITE, or LoRA-Muon; AdaFactor requires both relative_step and warmup_init to be disabled.
field.loraplus_lr_ratioHint: A ratio of 2 doubles the learning rate of the designated group while leaving the other group unchanged. A ratio of 1 gives both groups the same rate. Watch for overfitting at higher ratios.
field.loraplus_unet_lr_ratioHint: Leave blank to use the global LoRA+ ratio.
field.loraplus_unet_lr_ratioHint_anima: Leave blank to use the global LoRA+ ratio.
field.loraplus_text_encoder_lr_ratioHint: Applies only when training the text encoder. Leave blank to use the global LoRA+ ratio.
field.scale_weight_norms: Maximum norm regularization for network weights
field.network_args_customHint: Enter one key=value pair per line. The LoRA+ controls manage its ratios; duplicate entries here do not override them.
field.base_weightsHint: LoRA weight paths merged before training, separated by commas.
field.base_weights_multiplierHint: Merge multiplier per base_weights entry, comma-separated; the count must match.
field.keep_tokensHint: Keeps the specified number of leading tags, such as a trigger word, from being shuffled or individually dropped. Full-caption dropout can still remove the entire caption.
field.shuffle_captionHint: Shuffles caption tags during training to reduce dependence on their order. Leading tags marked for retention stay in place. Unavailable when Anima text encoder outputs are cached.
field.weighted_captionsHint: Supported only by the SDXL path. Anima tokenization does not support weighted tokens.
field.caption_dropout_rateHint: Randomly trains with an empty caption while still using the image. This adds training without text conditioning; high rates reduce opportunities to learn text–image associations.
field.caption_dropout_rateHint_sdxl: Randomly uses an empty caption without skipping the image. High rates reduce text–image pairing. Cannot be used with text encoder output caching.
field.caption_dropout_rateHint_anima: Randomly uses an empty caption without skipping the image. High rates reduce text–image pairing. Rebuild existing disk text encoder caches after changing this setting.
field.caption_tag_dropout_rateHint: Randomly omits individual tags so training does not always use the full tag combination. Leading tags marked for retention are preserved. Unavailable when Anima text encoder outputs are cached.
field.sample_promptsHint: The preview generator reads comma-separated tags or natural-language text. Example: 1girl, smile, cherry blossoms
field.sample_cfgHint: Controls how strongly previews follow the prompt. Very high values can cause artifacts. Affects previews only, not training.
field.sampleResolutionHint: Changes preview dimensions only. Higher resolutions usually need more GPU memory and generation time.
field.sample_seedHint: Keep the prompt and seed fixed to compare changes across training checkpoints.
field.sample_stepsHint: Number of sampling steps used to generate each preview. More steps take longer and do not change the number of training updates.
field.negative_promptsHint: Negative conditioning for previews; it affects only preview images generated during training.
field.mixed_precisionHint: Uses lower precision for part of the training computation to reduce GPU memory use. It does not set the storage precision of every weight and optimizer state.
field.full_bf16: Cast model and LoRA parameters to BF16
field.full_bf16Hint: Keeps model and trainable parameters in BF16 as well as using BF16 computation. Can save more GPU memory, with lower parameter precision than regular mixed-precision training.
field.full_bf16_automagicLocked: Automagic3 compatibility mode requires FP32 LoRA trainable parameters; full_bf16 is disabled.
field.xformersHint: Requires a compatible xformers installation; focuses on reducing attention VRAM.
field.sdpaHint: Uses the native PyTorch implementation with no extra extension dependency.
field.cache_latentsHint: Encodes training images in advance and reuses the results, avoiding repeated VAE encoding during training.
field.cache_latents_to_diskHint: Stores encoded image latents on disk for reuse and lower RAM use, at the cost of disk space.
field.cache_text_encoder_outputs_to_disk: Save text encoder outputs to disk
field.no_half_vaeHint: Disables half-precision VAE computation, which isolates latent NaNs caused by the VAE's half-precision numeric range; higher-precision VAE computation uses more VRAM.
field.lowramHint: Reduces system RAM usage at the cost of additional VRAM.
field.v_parameterizationHint: Used only by SDXL models trained with a v-prediction target; it must match the base model objective.
field.zero_terminal_snrHint: Used only by SDXL and requires v_parameterization to be enabled.
field.max_grad_normHint: Scales gradients down when their norm exceeds the threshold, limiting unusually large updates from individual batches. Very low thresholds can suppress useful learning. Set to 0 to disable.
field.max_grad_normHint_lora_muon: The Anima starting point for LoRA-Muon is 0, so no extra global L2 clipping runs before optimizer.step; that step is not part of the paper algorithm. You can still enter a positive value to suppress abnormal gradient spikes.
field.huber_cHint: Base value of the Huber loss threshold, adjusted over training by the schedule; default 0.1.
field.huber_scaleHint: Controls the overall scale of the Huber Loss threshold. Default: 1.0.
field.qwen3Hint: Enter a .safetensors file path or a local HuggingFace model directory.
field.timestep_samplingHint: Controls which noise levels are sampled more often. High noise generally emphasizes global structure and composition; low noise emphasizes local details such as texture and linework.
field.sigmoid_scaleHint: With no timestep shift, lower values concentrate sampling around medium noise levels. Higher values make low- and high-noise timesteps more common.
field.discrete_flow_shiftHint: Values above 1 favor high-noise timesteps; values below 1 favor low-noise timesteps. Use 1 for no shift. Applies to shift and sigma sampling only.
field.weighting_schemeHint: Controls loss weighting after a timestep is sampled. The logit_normal and mode options instead change sampling frequency in sigma mode, without adding loss weights.
field.logit_meanHint: Applies only with timestep_sampling=sigma and weighting_scheme=logit_normal.
field.logit_stdHint: Applies only with timestep_sampling=sigma and weighting_scheme=logit_normal.
field.mode_scaleHint: Applies only with timestep_sampling=sigma and weighting_scheme=mode.
field.min_timestepHint: Leave blank to use the default of 0.
field.max_timestepHint: Leave blank to use the default of 1000.
field.textTokenLengthHint: Captions longer than the limit are truncated. The limit counts tokenizer tokens, not tags or characters.
field.attn_modeHint: torch/SDPA use native PyTorch; xformers focuses on VRAM savings and needs an extra dependency; flash requires compatible hardware and an installed extension.
field.split_attnHint: Computes attention in chunks to reduce VRAM; enabled automatically when xformers is selected.
field.vae_chunk_sizeHint: Must be even. Reduces peak VRAM at a speed cost; empty disables chunking.
field.vae_disable_cacheHint: Disables the VAE internal cache to reduce VRAM, and encoding/decoding also becomes faster; this differs from official behavior.
field.blocks_to_swapHint: Keeps some DiT blocks in system memory and moves them to the GPU when needed. Saves GPU memory; larger counts usually add transfer overhead. Set to 0 to disable.
field.conv_dimHint: Sets a separate rank for non-1x1 convolutions (e.g. 3x3) in LyCORIS modules; 1x1 convolutions keep using network_dim, and an empty value falls back to network_dim.
field.conv_dimHintNative: Sets a separate rank for convolution layers (1x1 convolutions use network_dim); empty means convolution layers are not trained.
field.conv_alphaHint: Sets a separate alpha for convolution layers; an empty value falls back to network_alpha.
field.conv_alphaHintNative: Sets a separate alpha for convolution layers; an empty value uses 1.0.
field.conv_dimHintNative_anima: Applies to convolution layers only; Anima has no convolution layers, so this has no effect. You can leave it empty.
field.conv_dimHint_anima: Applies to convolution layers only; Anima has no convolution layers, so this has no effect. You can leave it empty.
field.conv_alphaHintNative_anima: Applies to convolution layers only; Anima has no convolution layers, so this has no effect. You can leave it empty.
field.conv_alphaHint_anima: Applies to convolution layers only; Anima has no convolution layers, so this has no effect. You can leave it empty.
field.lokr_factorHint: Controls how dimensions are split between LoKr’s two factors, affecting the parameter count and the weight changes the adapter can represent. Use -1 for automatic selection; check the structure preview for the result.
field.use_tuckerHint: Applies Tucker decomposition to non-1x1 convolution layers to reduce parameter count; it has no effect when the selected preset targets no convolution layers.
field.use_tuckerHintNative: Applies Tucker decomposition to non-1x1 convolution layers to reduce parameter count.
field.use_scalarHint: Multiplies the module output by a trainable scaling coefficient that is learned during training; supported only by some LyCORIS algorithms.
field.decompose_bothHint: Attempts to further factorize both Kronecker factors into smaller matrices to save parameters. Whether each factor is decomposed depends on its size and the rank.
field.full_matrixHint: Keeps the LoKr factors as full matrices rather than further low-rank decompositions, retaining more adjustable parameters. The Kronecker structure still applies; this is not full fine-tuning.
field.train_normHint: Used only by LyCORIS to train LayerNorm and GroupNorm.
field.train_llm_adapterHint: Includes Anima LLMAdapterTransformerBlock layers in LyCORIS training. This increases trainable parameters and memory usage.
field.rank_dropoutHint: For standard LoRA, randomly disables low-rank channels during training to reduce reliance on a few channels. High rates can weaken learning. Set to 0 to disable.
field.module_dropoutHint: Randomly skips an entire adapter branch so the layer sometimes uses only its base-model output. High rates give the branch fewer opportunities to learn. Set to 0 to disable.
field.lycoris_dropoutHint: Sets feature dropout for LyCORIS to reduce reliance on fixed feature combinations. Overrides the general feature dropout setting when specified. Support depends on the algorithm.
field.lycoris_algoHint: Selects the LyCORIS parameterization. Only options supported by the current algorithm are shown.
field.lycorisNoteFullMatrixFactor: Full-matrix mode removes low-rank decomposition within the factors, not the Kronecker structure. The factor setting still applies, and the base model is not fully fine-tuned.
field.lycorisNoteTrainLlmAdapter: train_llm_adapter expands training targets to LLM adapter layers.
field.lycorisNoteDimFullMatrix: The LoKr dimension controls low-rank decomposition within each factor. Once the rank reaches a layer-dependent threshold, that factor may be stored as a full matrix, so further rank increases no longer add parameters to it. Check the structure preview for the actual result.
field.lycoris_presetHint: Chooses which DiT/UNet, text-encoder, attention, MLP, or convolution modules are trained.
field.lycoris_anima_sd_defaultHint: Matches the sd-scripts native default: only attention and MLP of each Block are trained; the AdaLN modulation branches, embeddings, the output layer, and norm layers stay excluded.
field.lycoris_anima_train_adalnHint: Adds AdaLN modulation layers when the attn-mlp preset is aligned with the sd-scripts default scope.
field.lycoris_kernel_backendHint: Selects the LyCORIS computation backend. Auto tries available backends in a predefined order. First use may require compilation.
field.dora_wdHint: Decomposes weight magnitude and direction. Neuron-level dropout is ignored while rank and module dropout remain available.
field.bypass_modeHint: Computes the adapter branch directly instead of first rebuilding the full weight matrix, reducing intermediate work. Some quantized layers use this path automatically.
field.rs_loraHint: Reduces how quickly the adapter scale decreases as the rank grows, for use in higher-rank training. The same Alpha will produce a different scale from standard LoRA.
field.unbalanced_factorizationHint: Changes how dimensions are allocated between the two factors. Compare the resulting shapes and file size in the structure preview.
field.wd_on_outputHint: DoRA decomposition axis: output when enabled, input when disabled.
field.torch_compileHint: Compiles on first use; switch Windows inductor runs to eager if errors occur.
field.dynamo_backendHint: inductor favors performance; eager favors compatibility; cudagraphs reduces launch overhead.
field.dim_from_weights: Infer LoRA rank from existing weights
field.dim_from_weightsHint: Reads the rank from the existing LoRA instead of using the manually entered network dimension.
field.cuda_allow_tf32Hint: Supported only on Ampere and newer GPUs; it may improve matrix performance on compatible hardware.
field.cuda_cudnn_benchmarkHint: The trainer benchmarks available cuDNN convolution algorithms for observed tensor shapes and caches the selected algorithm. Shape changes can trigger additional benchmarking.
field.vae_batch_sizeHint: Leave blank to use the default of 1. Larger batches can speed up caching but use more VRAM.
field.cpu_offload_checkpointingHint: Offloads checkpoint tensors to CPU; incompatible with Unsloth asynchronous offload.
field.unsloth_offload_checkpointingHint: Asynchronously offloads checkpoint tensors to CPU; incompatible with standard CPU checkpoint offload and block swapping.
field.compileHint: Compiles DiT block by block; automatically disabled when Block Swap is enabled.
field.compile_fullgraphHint: Requires torch.compile to capture the complete computation graph without graph breaks.
field.persistent_data_loader_workersHint: Reduces inter-epoch waits and is useful for large datasets; uses slightly more RAM.
field.max_data_loader_n_workersHint: Leave blank to use the default of 8. Lower values use less RAM; higher values can speed up data loading but use more system resources.
field.save_last_n_epochsHint: Use with save_every_n_epochs to limit disk space used by saved models. Leave blank for no retention limit.
field.save_state_on_train_end: Save final training state at training end
field.save_state_on_train_endHint: Saves a resumable training state when training ends, independently of periodic saves.
field.debiased_estimation_lossHint: Applies debiased per-timestep loss weighting; mainly for v-prediction training.
field.noise_offset_random_strengthHint: When enabled, the offset strength is sampled randomly between 0 and noise_offset.
field.noise_offsetHint: Adds a fixed offset to the noise, helping learn very dark or bright images; leave blank to disable.
field.adaptive_noise_scaleHint: Applies only after noise_offset is set and adjusts noise-offset strength from image statistics.
field.min_snr_gammaHint: Weights each timestep's Loss with the signal-to-noise ratio clamped at γ, limiting the relative weight of low-noise timesteps. Empty applies no Min-SNR weighting.
field.multires_noise_iterationsHint: SDXL multires noise iterations; ignored by Anima.
field.multires_noise_discountHint: Effective only when multires noise iterations are enabled.
field.ip_noise_gammaHint: Controls input-perturbation regularization strength; Anima applies it during noising.
field.ip_noise_gamma_random_strength: Random strength for input perturbation noise
field.ip_noise_gamma_random_strengthHint: When enabled, the perturbation strength is sampled randomly between 0 and ip_noise_gamma.
field.prior_loss_weightHint: Loss weight for regularization images. Default 1.0.
field.cache_text_encoder_outputsHint: Avoids encoding captions again during training.
field.cache_text_encoder_outputsHint_sdxl: Incompatible with caption dropout, shuffle, and tag dropout.
field.cache_text_encoder_outputsHint_anima: Incompatible with caption shuffle and tag dropout.
field.cache_text_encoder_outputsLocked: The current caption settings are incompatible with text caching.
field.network_dropoutHint: For standard LoRA, randomly masks intermediate features during training to reduce reliance on fixed feature combinations. High rates can weaken learning. Set to 0 to disable.
field.scale_weight_normsHint: Applies max-norm regularization to network weights at the entered limit; empty leaves weight norms unconstrained by this control.
field.sample_flow_shiftHint: Adjusts the flow-matching denoising schedule for Anima previews; it does not change the training timestep distribution.
field.samplePromptsCountHint: {n} prompt lines → {n} preview images per sample
field.max_train_epochsHint: One epoch uses the full training dataset, including its configured repeats. More epochs extend training; training for too long can lead to overfitting.
field.lycoris_dropoutHint_lokr: In the bypass path, randomly masks adapter outputs to reduce reliance on fixed feature combinations. The weight-rebuild path does not use this setting.
field.rank_dropoutHint_lokr: In the weight-rebuild path, randomly masks the adapter update for some output channels. The bypass path does not use this setting.
field.network_alphaHint_lokr_full: When both factors are full matrices, Alpha is set to the network dimension. The scale is 1 with rs_lora off, or the square root of the dimension with it on.
field.loraplus_lr_ratioHint_standard_lora: For standard LoRA, a ratio of 2 doubles the learning rate of lora_up while leaving lora_down unchanged. A ratio of 1 gives both groups the same rate. Watch for overfitting at higher ratios.

shapePreview.w1Help: The first Kronecker factor in LoKr, stored as a full matrix or formed by multiplying two low-rank matrices.
shapePreview.w2Help: The second Kronecker factor in LoKr. Its Kronecker product with W1 forms the weight update matrix.
shapePreview.scaleHelp: The coefficient applied to the weight update matrix, determined by the effective Alpha, Rank, and scaling method.
shapePreview.rankHelp: Controls low-rank factor dimensions. Once a LoKr factor uses full storage, increasing Rank no longer adds parameters to that factor.
shapePreview.alphaHelp: Together with Rank, controls update scaling without changing matrix shapes or file size. This is the effective value for the selected layer.
shapePreview.factorHelp: Controls how LoKr splits input and output dimensions, affecting W1/W2 shapes, parameter counts, and full-storage thresholds.
shapePreview.thresholdHelp: W2 switches to full storage when this layer's Rank reaches this value. Full Matrix forces full storage at any Rank.
shapePreview.sizeHelp: Saved weights across all layers in this group, affected by decomposition, layer count, and save precision. Total file size is shown at the top.
shapePreview.paramHelp: Trainable parameters for one layer; the percentage compares them with the original full weight matrix.
shapePreview.empty: No trainable modules selected by this configuration.
shapePreview.title: Matrix structure preview
shapePreview.subtitle: How the current network module splits weights into trainable matrices
shapePreview.scaleForced: 1 (W1 and W2 are both full matrices, so training forces α = rank)
shapePreview.factorAutoNote: factor = -1: split automatically into out = {outL} × {outK}, in = {inM} × {inN}.
shapePreview.factorFixedNote: factor = {factor}: out and in are each split into two blocks ({outL} × {outK}, {inM} × {inN}).
shapePreview.w2AutoFullNote: rank {rank} is not below max({outK}, {inN}) / 2, so this layer stores a full W2. Each layer decides independently; the result still uses a Kronecker product.
shapePreview.w2FullMatrixNote: Full Matrix is on: W2 always stays a full matrix, and raising Rank no longer adds w2 parameters.
shapePreview.w1LowRankNote: decompose_both applies: rank {rank} is below {threshold}, so W1 is low-rank too.
shapePreview.w1StaysFullNote: decompose_both is on, but rank {rank} is not below {threshold}, so W1 stays a full matrix.
shapePreview.unbalancedNote: unbalanced_factorization is on: the two blocks on the output side are swapped.
shapePreview.rsLoraNote: rs_lora is on: scaling uses α / √rank instead of α / rank.
shapePreview.useScalarNote: use_scalar is on: the whole ΔW is multiplied by a learnable scalar.
shapePreview.convNote: conv_dim = {dim}: applies only to 3×3 convolutions; the diagram shows a linear layer.
shapePreview.doraNote: DoRA is on: it stores {count} extra magnitude parameters along the {axis} axis.
shapePreview.llmAdapterNote: LLM Adapter layers are trained as well and have different shapes.
shapePreview.adalnNote: AdaLN modulation layers are trained as well and have different shapes.
shapePreview.unknown: Structure preview is not available for this network module.
shapePreview.loraCaption: ΔW = B × A, then multiplied by the scaling factor
shapePreview.lohaCaption: ΔW = (B₁ × A₁) ⊙ (B₂ × A₂), then multiplied by the scaling factor
shapePreview.kronCaption: The weight is split by factor into two Kronecker blocks: out = {outL} × {outK}, in = {inM} × {inN}
shapePreview.kronFormula: ΔW = {w1} ⊗ {w2}, then multiplied by the scaling factor
shapePreview.kronFormulaScale1: ΔW = {w1} ⊗ {w2}, with the scaling factor fixed at 1
shapePreview.diagramAlt: Weight decomposition diagram for the current configuration
shapePreview.footnote: Shapes and counts come from the network constructed for this configuration. File estimates include tensors and their index, excluding variable training metadata and optimizer checkpoints. Shapes use a logarithmic scale; numeric dimensions are exact.

tagger.characterThresholdDesc: Controls character-name filtering. Higher values produce more conservative output.
tagger.characterRecognitionDesc: Controls whether the current WD model outputs character-name tags.

tagger.presetDesc: Macro uses lower thresholds and retains more tags. Micro uses higher thresholds and produces more conservative output. Editing a category switches to Custom.

tagger.presetMicroDesc: Uses higher category thresholds, producing fewer tags with a precision bias.
tagger.presetOnnxRecallDesc: Lowers general and character thresholds to retain more candidates.
tagger.presetOnnxBalancedDesc: Uses medium thresholds to balance tag count and false positives.
tagger.presetOnnxPreciseDesc: Raises general and character thresholds to retain higher-confidence tags only.
tagger.presetCustomDesc: Keeps the current manually configured thresholds or maximum tag count.
tagger.clPresetDesc: Macro uses a 0.35 threshold and a 0.6 character threshold. Micro uses 0.45 and 0.7. Editing a category switches to Custom.

tagger.excludeTagsDesc: Tags to exclude from results, comma separated

opt.model_train_type_sdxl-lora: Stable Diffusion XL series LoRA training
opt.save_model_as_ckpt: PyTorch LoRA weights with a .ckpt extension
opt.save_precision_bf16: BF16 save precision, wider numeric range
opt.lr_scheduler_cosine_with_restarts: Lowers the learning rate along a cosine curve. Restarts when the cycle count is greater than 1.
opt.lr_scheduler_cosine: Cosine annealing, smoothly reduces learning rate
opt.lr_scheduler_constant: Keeps the scheduled learning rate constant.
opt.optimizer_type_AdamW: A general-purpose baseline for comparing learning rates, datasets, and training duration.
opt.optimizer_type_AdamW8bit: Reduces memory use by storing larger optimizer states in 8-bit format.
opt.optimizer_type_PagedAdamW8bit: AdamW8bit with paging: swaps optimizer states to system RAM under memory pressure, slowing training while swapping.
opt.optimizer_type_StableAdamW: Adds RMS clipping of update magnitude on top of AdamW, capping per-step update size.
opt.optimizer_type_Lion: Uses the sign of a momentum-based update. Tune its learning rate separately from AdamW.
opt.optimizer_type_Lion8bit: Lion with 8-bit momentum state, for lower memory use.
opt.optimizer_type_PagedLion8bit: Lion8bit with paging: swaps momentum states to system RAM under memory pressure.
opt.optimizer_type_Prodigy: D-adaptation: estimates the step-size scale during training; base learning rate stays fixed at 1.0. The estimate needs some steps to converge, so very short runs may end before it does.
opt.optimizer_type_ProdigyPlus: Prodigy combined with Schedule-Free: automatic step-size estimation plus in-optimizer scheduling.
opt.optimizer_type_Automagic3: Adjusts per-group learning rates from gradient-sign history with internal update clipping.
opt.optimizer_type_AdaFactor: Factorized squared-gradient states for low memory; with relative_step on, the learning rate is derived from training progress.
opt.optimizer_type_AdamWScheduleFree: Replaces external learning-rate scheduling with parameter averaging.
opt.optimizer_type_CAME: Adds residual confidence scaling and internal RMS clipping to AdamW-style updates, with factorized states for lower memory.
opt.optimizer_type_EmoSens: Adjusts the learning rate based on loss changes and suggests when to stop. Does not stop training automatically.
opt.optimizer_type_Muon: Accumulates gradient momentum, then approximately orthogonalizes the update of 2-D matrices.
opt.optimizer_type_LoRAMuon: Processes both LoRA factors jointly to reduce sensitivity to how their scales are distributed. Supports native Anima LoRA only and requires separate learning rate tuning.
opt.optimizer_type_Adan: Uses changes between consecutive gradients to adjust updates. Compare it with AdamW to assess convergence speed.
opt.optimizer_type_AdEMAMix: Maintains fast (β1=0.9) and slow (β3=0.9999) gradient moving averages so early gradients keep contributing to updates; designed for long runs — in short runs the slow memory has barely accumulated.
opt.optimizer_type_AdEMAMix8bit: AdEMAMix with 8-bit optimizer states; same update formula.
opt.optimizer_type_LoRARite: Designed for paired LoRA factors to reduce sensitivity to equivalent representations.
opt.optimizer_type_SOAP: Uses gradient correlations to choose an update basis, then applies Adam-style updates. Adds computation compared with ordinary AdamW.
opt.krea_timestep_sampling_uniform: Samples timesteps uniformly across the full noise range.
opt.krea_timestep_sampling_sigmoid: Maps normal random values through sigmoid, producing a distribution concentrated toward the middle of the timestep range.
opt.krea_timestep_sampling_sigma: Uses weighting_scheme to select uniform, Logit-Normal, or Mode timestep density.
opt.krea_timestep_sampling_shift: Samples with sigmoid first, then shifts the distribution by fixed discrete_flow_shift.
opt.krea_timestep_sampling_krea2_shift: Computes the Krea 2 shift from the current resolution instead of using fixed discrete_flow_shift.
opt.krea_timestep_sampling_logsnr: Samples from the Log-SNR normal distribution defined by logit_mean and logit_std.
opt.krea_weighting_scheme_none: Changes neither timestep density nor per-timestep Loss weights.
opt.krea_lr_scheduler_inverse_sqrt: After linear warmup, decays in inverse proportion to the square root of the training step.
opt.krea_lr_scheduler_cosine_with_min_lr: Cosine decay down to the configured minimum learning rate.
opt.krea_lr_scheduler_warmup_stable_decay: Runs warmup, a stable constant phase, then a final decay phase.
opt.krea_lr_scheduler_rex: Warms from the minimum learning rate to the base value, then follows the REX curve back to the minimum.
opt.krea_attention_sdpa: Uses native PyTorch scaled dot-product attention (SDPA) without an additional attention-extension dependency.
opt.krea_attention_flash_attn: FlashAttention implementation; requires an installed build compatible with the current CUDA, PyTorch, and GPU.
opt.krea_attention_sage_attn: SageAttention implementation; requires a separately installed compatible version and supported GPU environment.
opt.krea_attention_xformers: xFormers memory-efficient attention; requires xformers and can be a compatibility option when VRAM is constrained.
opt.loss_type_l1: L1 Loss (MAE), more robust to outliers
opt.loss_type_l2: L2 Loss (MSE), more sensitive to large errors
opt.loss_type_huber: Huber Loss, combines advantages of L1 and L2
opt.loss_type_smooth_l1: Smooth L1 Loss, smoother near zero
opt.network_module_networks_lora: Standard LoRA network for SD/SDXL architectures
opt.network_module_networks_loha: Represents weight changes as an elementwise product of two low-rank products, giving a different parameterization from standard LoRA.
opt.network_module_networks_lokr: Represents weight changes with a Kronecker product of two smaller matrices. Decomposition settings control the parameter count.
opt.network_module_lycoris_kohya: LyCORIS Library, supporting LoCon, LoHa, LoKr, and related modes
opt.lycoris_preset_full: All target layers in UNet/DiT and text encoder, including convolution
opt.lycoris_preset_full_lin: UNet/DiT and text-encoder linear layers, excluding convolution
opt.lycoris_preset_attn_mlp: Transformer attention and MLP layers, including the text encoder, no convolution blocks
opt.lycoris_preset_attn_only: Attention layers in the UNet and text encoder; usually matches nothing on Anima/DiT models
opt.lycoris_preset_unet_only: All UNet/DiT modules and convolution only; the text encoder is not trained.
opt.lycoris_preset_unet_transformer: UNet/DiT Transformer blocks only, excluding the text encoder
opt.lycoris_preset_unet_convblock: UNet convolution and ResNet blocks only; not applicable to DiT
opt.lycoris_kernel_backend_triton: Uses Triton; requires a compatible environment.
opt.lycoris_kernel_backend_tilelang: Fused TileLang kernels; falls back automatically when not installed
opt.lycoris_kernel_backend_compile: Compiles each op; the first run is slower
opt.sample_sampler_euler_a: Euler Ancestral sampler with stochastic steps
opt.mixed_precision_bf16: BFloat16 mixed precision; requires BF16 GPU support
opt.mixed_precision_no: No mixed precision (FP32), highest VRAM usage
opt.timestep_sampling_sigmoid: sigmoid — normal mapped through sigmoid, concentrated mid-range
opt.weighting_scheme_sigma_sqrt: Weights loss by 1 / sigma²; does not change the sampling distribution
opt.weighting_scheme_logit_normal: Samples timesteps from a Logit-Normal distribution only with sigma sampling; adds no loss weighting
opt.weighting_scheme_mode: Samples timesteps from the Mode distribution only with sigma sampling; adds no loss weighting
opt.weighting_scheme_cosmap: Applies Cosine Map loss weighting; does not change the sampling distribution
opt.weighting_scheme_uniform: Uses the same loss weight at every timestep. Does not change how often each timestep is sampled.
opt.attn_mode_flash: Flash Attention; requires a compatible GPU and runtime
opt.huber_schedule_snr: SNR-based dynamic schedule, adaptively adjusts Huber threshold
opt.dynamo_backend_inductor: Default compilation backend focused on performance
opt.dynamo_backend_eager: Immediate execution backend focused on compatibility and debugging
opt.dynamo_backend_cudagraphs: Uses CUDA Graph to reduce kernel launch overhead
opt.compile_backend_inductor: Default backend focused on runtime performance
opt.compile_backend_eager: Immediate execution backend focused on compatibility
opt.compile_backend_cudagraphs: Reduces kernel launch overhead via CUDA Graph
opt.compile_dynamic_true: Enable dynamic shapes; Windows may require Visual Studio 2022 C++ tools
